mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of adding a mother-in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a senior living suite varies widely based on whether you remodel existing interior space, convert an attached garage, or construct a full home addition from the ground up. Key factors that shape the budget include plumbing installation for a private bathroom, dedicated kitchen or kitchenette hookups, electrical panel upgrades, and independent heating and cooling zones. Finish choices such as custom cabinetry and zero-threshold tile work also impact costs. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms provides detailed estimates and negotiable pricing options to align projects with household budgets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Total cost depends on whether you build new square footage or remodel existing rooms, plus the need for new plumbing, electrical lines, HVAC, and accessible fixtures.
